Management Plan

- Suggested initial treatment trial with ibuprofen plus antiemetic medication (over-the-counter) and intake of sugary carbonated drinks (e.g., Coke) to relieve migraine symptoms.

- Planned follow-up appointment for detailed neurological examination to exclude other causes if symptoms persist or worsen.
